notices.short_title: Notice of Adoption of Rules for Mergers and Apportionments of Real Property Tax Lots.
notices.plain: The Department of Finance has adopted rules governing how real property tax lots are merged and apportioned, according to a notice published March 9, 2026.

notices.short_title: Family Enrichment Centers RFP - New Award 06822P0002
notices.plain: The Administration for Children's Services awarded Forestdale Inc a $2,187,500 contract for family enrichment center services, chosen from competing proposals within a pre-qualified list of approved vendors.
The Administration for Children's Services intends to award a negotiated contract for Extraordinary Needs Foster Care Services, with responses due March 20, 2026.
Brooklyn Bridge Park is seeking proposals for sanitation and custodial services, with responses due April 6, 2026.

notices.short_title: Bid 2500063 - HACH Process Analyzers, Lab Equipment - DEP
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Hach Company a $5.7 million contract for process analyzers and laboratory equipment for the Department of Environmental Protection, chosen through competitive sealed bidding where the lowest qualified bid wins.

notices.short_title: NAE ADA Compliance at DCAS Court Buildings
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services intends to award a contract for accessibility compliance work at Department of Citywide Administrative Services court buildings, using a negotiated acquisition with one or a few vendors instead of open competition.

The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Fisher Scientific Company, LLC a $2 million contract for medical and laboratory supplies and equipment, bought through a contract another government already holds.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Hunger Free America, Inc. a $520,834 contract for outreach to low-income households about the SNAP food assistance program, using a required or authorized source.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.vendor_name: University Consultation and Treatment Center for Mental Hygiene
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration renewed its contract with University Consultation and Treatment Center for Mental Hygiene for non-emergency housing services, worth $1,954,608.

notices.short_title: Shelter Services for Homeless Single Adults
notices.plain: The Department of Homeless Services intends to renew its contract for shelter services for homeless single adults, with responses due March 10, 2026.
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Jerome Environmental Services LLC a $2.5 million renewal contract for lead abatement work.

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Certified Environmental, Inc. a $3.85 million construction contract for lead-based paint hazard abatement, selected through competitive sealed bids in which the lowest qualified bid wins.

The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications renewed its citywide system integration contract with World Wide Technology LLC for up to $50 million, as reported in a March 9, 2026 award notice.

notices.short_title: 80125P0049-Business Solution & Industrial Business Zone Center RFP
notices.plain: The Department of Small Business Services is seeking proposals from vendors to run a business solutions and Industrial Business Zone center, with responses due April 17, 2026.
The Trust for Governors Island is seeking proposals from firms to perform a 2026 audit, with responses due April 3, 2026.
The Board of Elections is seeking public comment on contract awards for generators to be used during early voting, under a contract period running from 2026 to 2030.

notices.short_title: Orchard Beach Public Address System Design and Installation Contract
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation has published a notice about a contract for the design and installation of a public address system at Orchard Beach, open for public comment as of March 9, 2026.
The Department of Transportation published a notice on March 9, 2026, about a public comment period on contract awards for fire sprinkler standpipe repair and maintenance.
The notice gives only its title, so I can say only that the Board Meetings listing appeared in the public hearings and meetings section of The City Record on March 9, 2026.

notices.short_title: Board of Standards and Appeals Public Hearing Notice
notices.plain: The Board of Standards and Appeals will hold a public hearing on March 23, 2026, according to a notice published March 9, 2026.
The Community Boards agency will hold a public hearing on March 10, 2026, according to this notice published March 9, 2026.

notices.short_title: NOTICE OF FILING - COMMUNITY SCHOOL DISTRICT 24
notices.plain: The School Construction Authority published a notice on March 9, 2026, announcing a filing for Community School District 24 under its Special Materials section.
